# Fransys

> Fransys is a Python toolkit for electrical cabinet and harness design.

The documentation is versioned. Latest release: 0.19.10.

- Latest: https://olejbondahl.github.io/fransys/latest/llms.txt (the whole guide in one file: https://olejbondahl.github.io/fransys/latest/llms-full.txt)
- A given release: https://olejbondahl.github.io/fransys/<X.Y.Z>/llms.txt, for example https://olejbondahl.github.io/fransys/0.19.10/llms.txt
- Markdown of any page: its URL plus index.md, under the same version path
- Pick the version from the installed `fransys.__version__`
